verdict.rationale: AngelList documents fundraising ("Launch your round or RUV, close investors, and collect capital") and shows convertible notes as cap-table holdings. Stakeholders can accept instruments by e-signature, and conversions produce an Excel pro forma. However, SAFE/note conversions are recorded only after being legally executed and uploaded, and the update FAQ points customers toward migrating to J.P. Morgan or Pulley, a material caveat for the equity product. Missing for 10: explicit docs on generating and sending SAFEs/convertible notes in-platform, evidence that conversion terms (cap, discount, MFN) are modeled live on the cap table rather than recorded after the fact, clarity on the product's continued availability, and independent hands-on corroboration.
